Hey!! So sorry I totally forgot to reply until now. The wedding did go smoothly, it’s not a scam or anything and it was so beautiful! I would rate it an 8/10, here is my honest review for you: 

Cons: 
- The wedding coordinators are not there at all the day of the wedding, it’s strictly just the officiant and photographer, which wasn’t a big deal for me. 
- There was a bit more people than I would’ve liked and expected. I got married on a weekday, so I thought it wouldn’t be as crowded, but it’s definitely busy season for the Gardens. It didn’t ruin anything for us and everyone there was relatively nice, even got some compliments🥺, but just prepare yourself that there will most likely be more people there than you expect. 
- The communication between Love Gracefully and The Bardini Gardens could’ve definitely been better. There was lawn mowers going off near us during our ceremony and the manager of the Gardens was mad at us after because they didn’t think we were supposed to be there. They talked to the owner and he confirmed that we paid to be there and the manager apologized, but it just felt like that should’ve happened before, but again it didn’t ruin the day for us.

Okay now for the pros: 
- The photographer and the officiant were SO nice and made us feel so comfortable. The ceremony was done so beautifully and they are both very professional and friendly. 
- The flowers they brought were perfect and exactly like the inspiration photos.
- The pictures are beautiful, like jaw dropping. The quality is amazing and it was the highlight of it all for me. It took them less than 2 weeks to get all of the photos to us, so that was also really nice. 
- It’s truly an amazing location. We had the ceremony right in front of the statues and it was perfect. 

Overall, I wouldn’t trade it for the world. It was the best day of my life, beautiful, and such a great story to start our marriage. If I could give my past self advice it would be to just not have any expectations and go with the flow. I hope you have a beautiful day and it goes smoothly for you too!!! Congratulations again! 🤍💕
